correctness.rationale: For clique order at least three and cycle order at least five, common-neighbor analysis gives exactly the cyclic word constraints; each cyclic length-three window has at most two occupied positions. A color-state transfer weighted by deficiency weighted by the triple-occupancy deficiency exactly enumerates words/packings; symmetry splits its determinant into a four-state factor and (m-1) copies of a three-state factor. Explicit formal log expansions to quadratic deficiency order yield all three closed optimum coefficients and their positivity. Direct vertex subset enumerations (up to 24 vertices), separate cyclic-word computations, and symbolic determinant factorizations independently corroborate bounded examples. The infinite claim rests on the proved transfer identity, not the finite checks.

value.rationale: A natural, exact two-parameter optimizer census refines a known sharp cardinality invariant, exhibiting cyclic closure parity phenomena and distinct mod-three asymptotic regimes. The associated full all-cardinality polynomial is a meaningful structural extension, with deterministic finite-state reproducibility and an independent direct graph interpretation, rather than a routine isolated graph computation.
